description.zh: CPU、内存、GPU、电池各一个百分比，配一条一分钟的走势；还有逐核负载、提交量、显存、磁盘剩余、网络和开机时长。显示哪几块由属性面板决定
description.en: CPU, memory, GPU and battery at a glance with a one-minute trace, plus per-core load, commit charge, VRAM, disk space, network and uptime. The inspector decides which of them show up

help.zh: CPU 和内存最近一分钟的曲线。关掉能省下大约 50px 高度
help.en: The last minute of CPU and memory. Turning it off gives back about 50px

help.zh: 一个逻辑核一根竖条。只有测到逐核数据的那一拍才画
help.en: One bar per logical core, drawn only on ticks that measured them

help.zh: 占用率与显存。读不到显卡计数器的机器上这一行本来就不会出现
help.en: Utilisation and VRAM. On machines without readable GPU counters the row never appears anyway

help.zh: 电量和充电状态。台式机没有电池，那一行不会出现
help.en: Charge and charging state. Desktops have no battery, so the row stays hidden there

label.en: Show disk space and process count

help.zh: 底栏第一行：系统盘剩余空间、进程数
help.en: First footer row: free space on the system volume, and the process count

help.zh: 底栏第二行：每秒收发的字节数
help.en: Second footer row: bytes per second in and out

items.zh: CPU 和内存各一个百分比，外加两者最近一分钟的走势。
items.en: CPU and memory as a percentage, plus a trace of the last minute for both.

items.zh: 一个逻辑核一根竖条，16 核机器上哪个核跑满了也看得出来。
items.en: One bar per logical core, so a single pegged core is visible on a 16-core machine.

items.zh: 内存还带提交量 —— 已提交对上限，上限里算进了页面文件。
items.en: Memory also shows commit — used against the limit, which includes the page file.

items.zh: 系统盘还剩多少、网络每秒收发多少、进程数，以及开机多久。
items.en: Free space on the system volume, network down and up per second, process count, and how long the machine has been up.

items.zh: 平台每秒采一次，卡片只负责把拿到的数画出来。
items.en: The platform samples once a second; the card only draws what it is handed.

items.zh: 线是历史，最新的在右边。采样从右往左填，所以刚打开的卡片是一小段线，不是一条平线。
items.en: The line is history, newest on the right. It fills in from the right as samples arrive, so a card you just opened shows a short line, not a flat one.

items.zh: CPU 是带填充的实线，内存是虚线。两条共用 0–100% 那套坐标，可以直接比。
items.en: CPU is the filled line; memory is the dashed one. Both use the same 0–100% scale, so you can compare them directly.

items.zh: CPU 尖一下而内存线不动，是一阵突发；内存线慢慢往上爬，是泄漏。
items.en: A tall spike with a flat memory line is a burst; a slowly rising memory line is a leak.

items.zh: 折线只留一分钟，而且只活在卡片里 —— 一个字节都不落盘。
items.en: The trace covers one minute and is kept in the card — nothing is written to disk.

items.zh: 一个逻辑核一根，从左往右，高度就是这个核的负载。
items.en: One bar per logical core, left to right, height is that core's load.

items.zh: 16 核机器上整机 6%，可能是一个核跑满，也可能全都闲着 —— 竖条能分出这两种。
items.en: A whole-machine figure of 6% on a 16-core machine can mean one core at 100% or all of them idle. The bars tell the two apart.

items.zh: 核数变了（休眠唤醒、热插拔）的那一拍这一行会收起来，而不是画成别的核的负载。
items.en: They disappear for a tick if the core count changes — waking from sleep or a hot-plug — rather than drawing the wrong core's load.

items.zh: CPU 是所有核加起来的总和 —— 16 核里一个核忙，整机只有 6% 左右。
items.en: CPU is the total across all cores — one busy core on a 16-core machine reads about 6%.

items.zh: 内存是物理内存的占用，缓存多的机器可以一直很高却没事。要看「真会分配失败」的那个数，看提交量。
items.en: Memory is physical RAM in use, so a machine with a lot of cache can sit high and still be fine. Watch commit for the number that actually fails allocations.

items.zh: 磁盘只算系统卷，别的盘不计入。
items.en: Disk is the system volume only; other drives are not counted.

items.zh: GPU 那个百分比是最忙的那条引擎，和任务管理器口径一致。把 3D、Copy、VideoDecode 几条加起来会超过 100%，那是错的。
items.en: The GPU figure is the busiest engine, the same number Task Manager shows. Adding 3D, Copy and VideoDecode together goes past 100%, which would be wrong.

items.zh: 混合显卡（核显 + 独显）取最忙的那一块，副标题写着是哪一块、多少显存。
items.en: On a hybrid laptop it picks the busier adapter, and the subline says which one and how much VRAM it has.

items.zh: 读不到显卡计数器时整行不出现 —— 那不是 0%，0% 是显卡闲着。
items.en: When the GPU counters cannot be read the row is simply absent — that is not 0%, which would mean the card is idle.

items.zh: 电池半分钟才问一次（电量变得很慢），电量和充电状态分两处看：数字是电量，下面一行是「充电中 / 用电池」和剩余时间。
items.en: Battery is polled every 30 seconds because charge moves slowly. The number is the charge; the line under it says charging or on battery, and how long is left.

items.zh: 台式机没有电池，那一行不出现。低于 20% 又没在充电时数字变黄。
items.en: Desktops have no battery, so the row is absent. The number turns amber below 20% while not charging.

items.zh: 属性面板里六个开关，一一对应六块内容：走势、逐核、GPU、电池、磁盘与进程数、网络速度。
items.en: Six switches in the inspector, one per block: trace, cores, GPU, battery, disk and process count, network speed.

items.zh: 开关只管显不显示，不改卡片尺寸 —— 卡片多大由你拖，组件不替你改。关掉几块之后觉得空，把它拖小就行。
items.en: A switch only hides a block; it never resizes the card. You own the size. If hiding a few blocks leaves it roomy, drag it smaller.

items.zh: 同一个组件配两次就是两种卡：一张只看电池，一张只看 CPU，各开各的开关。
items.en: The same widget placed twice becomes two different cards — one showing only battery, one showing only CPU — each with its own switches.

title.en: It stops when you cannot see it

items.zh: 把卡片藏起来或者最小化窗口，采样就停了 —— 没人看的监视器不该花电。
items.en: Hiding the card or minimising the window stops the sampling — a monitor nobody is looking at should not cost anything.

items.zh: 重新看得见的那一拍就接上，第一眼看到的就是当前读数。
items.en: It picks up again on the first tick after it becomes visible, so the first reading after that is already current.

items.zh: 平台没允许读系统指标。这个组件要读，所以需要「系统指标」这项权限。
items.en: The platform refused to read system metrics. The widget needs the system monitor permission.

items.zh: 在属性面板里重新授予，下一拍就恢复 —— 不用重启。
items.en: Grant it again and the card recovers on its next tick — no restart needed.

changes.zh: 电池那个独立组件并进来了：电量和充电状态成了这一张卡上的一行，`lattice.battery` 从商店下架。
changes.en: The separate battery widget is folded in: charge and charging state are one row here now, and lattice.battery is gone from the store.

changes.zh: 加了 GPU：占用率和显存。读不到显卡计数器的机器上整行不出现，而不是画一个 0%。
changes.en: GPU utilisation and VRAM. On machines without readable GPU counters the row is absent rather than showing 0%.

changes.zh: 属性面板里多了六个开关，决定六块内容各自显不显示。开关不改卡片尺寸。
changes.en: Six switches in the inspector decide which of the six blocks show. A switch never resizes the card.

changes.zh: 卡片默认长到 268×328 才装得下多出来的两行；老的卡片会被抬一次高度，不会挤成一团。
changes.en: The card grew to 268×328 to fit the two new rows; existing cards get their height raised once instead of being squeezed.

changes.zh: 界面和说明都支持中文了：行标签、单位、开机时长、提示行和属性面板跟着界面语言走，换语言当场重画。
changes.en: Interface and help are bilingual now: row labels, units, uptime, hints and the inspector follow the interface language, and repaint on a switch.

changes.zh: 加了一分钟走势：CPU 和内存各画一条，一眼能分出「突发一下」和「慢慢往上爬」。
changes.en: A one-minute trace of CPU and memory, so a burst and a slow climb look different.

changes.zh: 一个逻辑核一根竖条 —— 单个核跑满再也不会藏在整机那个偏低的总数后面。
changes.en: One bar per logical core — a single pegged core no longer hides behind a low whole-machine average.

changes.zh: 内存多了提交量对上限，磁盘那格从百分比换成剩余空间。
changes.en: Memory gained the commit charge against its limit, and free space replaces the bare disk percentage.

changes.zh: 底栏加了开机时长和进程数；线程数和句柄数在悬停提示里。
changes.en: Uptime and the process count join the footer; threads and handles are one hover away.

changes.zh: 卡片长到 268×240 才放得下折线；缩到 220×210 照样能用。
changes.en: The card grew to 268×240 to fit the trace; it still works down to 220×210.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：CPU、内存、磁盘、网络，由平台每秒采一次。
changes.en: First release: CPU, memory, disk and network, sampled once a second by the platform.

changes.zh: 默认放在顶层，压着别的窗口也读得清；想钉在桌面上可以在属性面板里改。
changes.en: Starts on the top layer so it stays readable over other windows; the inspector can pin it to the desktop instead.
